newsitem.title: USA: American General, USLIFE to close merger June 17.
newsitem.headline: American General, USLIFE to close merger June 17.

text.p: American General Corp and USLIFE Corp said Wednesday they expect to complete their merger, announced in February, on June 17, subject to shareholder approval.
All regulatory approvals have been obtained, they said.
The companies also said they have set the exchange ratio for the deal, with USLIFE shareholders receiving 1.1069 shares of American General common stock for each USLIFE common share.

Based on this exchange ratio and a projected 36.1 million USLIFE common shares outstanding at the closing, American General will issue about 40 million common shares in the transaction, bringing the total common equivalent shares outstanding to about 248.5 million.
USLIFE operates nationwide through three ordinary life insurance companies, a credit insurance group and six other financial services and support companies.
